paragraphs.text: I have a small dog. His name is Lucky. Lucky is white and brown. He is very cute.
paragraphs.translation: 我有一只小狗。它的名字叫 Lucky。Lucky 是白棕相间的。它非常可爱。

paragraphs.text: We go to the apple orchard. The orchard is near my home. There are many apple trees. The apples are red and green.
paragraphs.translation: 我们去苹果园。果园就在我家附近。那里有很多苹果树。苹果有红的，也有绿的。

paragraphs.text: Lucky runs under the trees. He can jump and run. He looks up at the apples. He wants one apple.
paragraphs.translation: Lucky 在树下跑来跑去。它会跳也会跑。它抬头看着树上的苹果。它想要一个苹果。

paragraphs.text: My father gives him an apple. Lucky likes the apple. He eats it very fast. His tail moves and moves.
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸给了它一个苹果。Lucky 很喜欢这个苹果。它吃得非常快。它的尾巴摇个不停。

paragraphs.text: I pick a big red apple. My mother picks three green apples. We put them in a bag. The bag is full now.
paragraphs.translation: 我摘了一个又大又红的苹果。妈妈摘了三个青苹果。我们把苹果放进袋子里。袋子现在装满了。

paragraphs.text: At home, we eat the apples. Lucky eats his apple too. We are all happy. I love my little dog.
paragraphs.translation: 回到家，我们一起吃苹果。Lucky 也吃它的苹果。我们都很开心。我爱我的小狗。

quiz.question: What color is the big apple?
quiz.audioText: What color is the big apple?
The apples are red and green.
